 ESPN’s Shams Charania reports that Gary Payton II and the Warriors have agreed to a one-year deal. 
 Payton II’s reported return to Golden State will mark his seventh season with the team. The veteran guard played a large role in the Warriors’ championship run during the 2021-22 season and remains a key contributor off the bench. He averaged a career-high 7.5 points last season across 73 regular-season games, but is not expected to have much fantasy impact in 2026-27.

That would mean more minutes for Gary Payton II as well, even though he does not share a position with Porziņǵis or Horford.

 Nikola Jokić finished Saturday’s win over the Pacers with 19 points (7-of-20 FGs, 4-of-4 FTs), 13 rebounds, eight assists, one steal, one block and one three-pointer.
 Jokić didn’t shoot well on Saturday, making six of his 17 two-point attempts. The good news for fantasy managers was that the three-time MVP committed just one turnover while finishing two assists shy of a triple-double. Jokić didn’t shoot efficiently, but his ball security kept fantasy managers from taking a major hit in two categories. The Nuggets play three games next week, starting with the Rockets on Monday.
